highlights: Agent Chat collapses cumulative Codex progress into one live status instead of hundreds of one-token thinking cards.
Restarted Fable and OpenClaw sessions keep their earlier transcript by following the complete session lineage.
Repeated terminal answers stay anchored at the bottom of long tool and sub-agent turns.
Expired browser sessions refresh and replay Agent Chat requests instead of silently losing history and stream calls.
Gateway-backed controls tolerate brief OpenClaw restart windows without retrying any request that may have been dispatched.
